links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of ChatGPT-4o answers to vertigo questions
links.effect: Diagnosis-related outputs were more difficult to read than other content types; the authors conclude the model needs improved readability. No numeric readability scores are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Readability analysis showed that diagnosis-related outputs were more challenging compared to other types of content.

screen.reason: The study empirically tests the diagnostic accuracy and response quality of ChatGPT-4o using simulated/retrospective outpatient vertigo cases and clinical questions evaluated by otologists.
